question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: Pellucid
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Clear**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Pellucid"** refers to something that is completely transparent, clear, or easy to understand. (स्पष्ट)
 
 
 
• **Example: **The pellucid waters of the lake allowed us to see the fish swimming at the bottom.
 
 
 
• **"Clear"** means something that is transparent, unambiguous, or free from confusion. (स्पष्ट)
 
 
 
• **Example: **Her clear instructions helped us complete the task without any mistakes.
